python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0001.png')

# Table leg mask (brown)
table_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img[:, :, 2] < 140) & (img[:, :, 0] < 40)
y_t, x_t = np.where(table_mask)
print('Table bbox: x=[', np.min(x_t), np.max(x_t), '], y=[', np.min(y_t), np.max(y_t), ']')
# find the bottom-most pixels of the table legs
legs_y = y_t[y_t > 320]
legs_x = x_t[y_t > 320]
print('Table legs contact y max:', np.max(y_t))

# Stool mask (between table and sofa)
# Let's inspect x between 130 and 175, y between 280 and 330
stool_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 0] < 100) & (img[:, :, 1] > 70) & (img[:, :, 1] < 90) & (img[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img[:, :, 2] < 90)
y_s, x_s = np.where(stool_mask)
# filter for x between 135 and 175
stool_pts = [(x, y) for x, y in zip(x_s, y_s) if 135 <= x <= 175]
if stool_pts:
    xs, ys = zip(*stool_pts)
    print(f'Stool: x=[{min(xs)}, {max(xs)}], y=[{min(ys)}, {max(ys)}]')
"
